parts: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
text: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
text_tl: Kung ipinahahayag natin ang ating mga kasalanan, ay tapat at banal siya na tayo'y patatawarin sa ating mga kasalanan, at tayo'y lilinisin sa lahat ng kalikuan.

parts: But the tax collector, standing far off, was unwilling even to lift up his eyes to heaven, but kept beating his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, the sinner.’
text: But the tax collector, standing far off, was unwilling even to lift up his eyes to heaven, but kept beating his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, the sinner.’
text_tl: Datapuwa't ang maniningil ng buwis, na nakatayo sa malayo, ay ayaw na itingin man lamang ang kaniyang mga mata sa langit, kundi dinadagukan ang kaniyang dibdib, na sinasabi, Dios, ikaw ay mahabag sa akin, na isang makasalanan.

parts:
Have mercy on me, O God, according to your lovingkindness;
according to the abundance of your compassion, blot out my transgressions.
text:
Have mercy on me, O God, according to your lovingkindness;
according to the abundance of your compassion, blot out my transgressions.
text_tl: Maawa ka sa akin, Oh Dios, ayon sa iyong kagandahang-loob: ayon sa karamihan ng iyong malumanay na mga kaawaan ay pinawi mo ang aking mga pagsalangsang.

parts:
My sin I made known to you, and my iniquity I did not cover.
I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,”
and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah
text:
My sin I made known to you, and my iniquity I did not cover.
I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,”
and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah
text_tl: Aking kinilala ang aking kasalanan sa iyo, at ang aking kasamaan ay hindi ko ikinubli: aking sinabi, aking ipahahayag ang aking pagsalangsang sa Panginoon; at iyong ipinatawad ang kasamaan ng aking kasalanan.

parts:
He who covers his transgressions does not prosper,
but he who confesses and forsakes them is shown mercy.
text:
He who covers his transgressions does not prosper,
but he who confesses and forsakes them is shown mercy.
text_tl: Siyang nagtatakip ng kaniyang mga pagsalangsang ay hindi giginhawa: nguni't ang nagpapahayag at nagiiwan ng mga yaon ay magtatamo ng kaawaan.

parts: Therefore let us draw near with confidence to the throne of grace, so that we may receive mercy and find grace for help in time of need.
text: Therefore let us draw near with confidence to the throne of grace, so that we may receive mercy and find grace for help in time of need.
text_tl: Magsilapit nga tayong may pagkakatiwala sa luklukan ng biyaya, upang tayo'y magsipagtamo ng awa, at mangakasumpong ng biyaya upang tumulong sa atin sa panahon ng pangangailangan.

parts:
The steadfast loves of the Lord! For we are not consumed;
for his mercies have not failed.
New every morning; great is your faithfulness.
text_tl:
Sa mga kaawaan nga ng Panginoon ay hindi tayo nalipol, sapagka't ang kaniyang mga habag ay hindi nauubos.
Ang mga yao'y bago tuwing umaga, dakila ang inyong pagtatapat.

parts: teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you. And look, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
text: teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you. And look, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
text_tl: Na ituro ninyo sa kanila na kanilang ganapin ang lahat ng mga bagay na iniutos ko sa inyo: at narito, ako'y sumasa inyong palagi, hanggang sa katapusan ng sanglibutan.

parts: “And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and receive you to Myself, that where I am, you may be also.
text: “And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and receive you to Myself, that where I am, you may be also.
text_tl: At kung ako'y pumaroon at kayo'y maipaghanda ng kalalagyan, ay muling paririto ako, at kayo'y tatanggapin ko sa aking sarili; upang kung saan ako naroroon, kayo naman ay dumoon.

parts: I urge, therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for all people,
text: I urge, therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for all people,
text_tl: Una-una nga sa lahat ng mga bagay, ay iniaaral ko na manaing, manalangin, mamagitan, at magpasalamat na patungkol sa lahat ng mga tao;

parts:
As far as the east is from the west,
so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
text:
As far as the east is from the west,
so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
text_tl: Kung gaano ang layo ng silanganan sa kalunuran, gayon inilayo niya ang mga pagsalangsang natin sa atin.

parts:
Who is a God like you,
pardoning iniquity and passing over transgression
for the remnant of his inheritance?
He does not hold fast his anger forever,
because he delights in steadfast love.

He will again have compassion on us; he will tread our iniquities underfoot;
and you will cast into the depths of the sea all their sins.
text:
Who is a God like you,
pardoning iniquity and passing over transgression
for the remnant of his inheritance?
He does not hold fast his anger forever,
because he delights in steadfast love.
He will again have compassion on us; he will tread our iniquities underfoot;
and you will cast into the depths of the sea all their sins.
text_tl:
Sino ang Dios na gaya mo, na nagpapatawad ng kasamaan, at pinalalagpas ang pagsalansang ng nalabi sa kaniyang mana? hindi niya pinipigil ang kaniyang galit ng magpakailan man, sapagka't siya'y nalulugod sa kagandahang-loob.
Siya'y muling magtataglay ng habag sa atin; kaniyang yayapakan ang ating kasamaan: at kaniyang ihahagis ang lahat nilang kasalanan sa mga kalaliman ng dagat.

Magsiparito kayo ngayon, at tayo'y magkatuwiranan, sabi ng Panginoon: bagaman ang inyong mga kasalanan ay maging tila mapula, ay magiging mapuputi na parang niebe; bagaman maging mapulang gaya ng matingkad na pula, ay magiging parang balahibo ng bagong paligong tupa,

parts: My little children, these things I write to you so that you may not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
text: My little children, these things I write to you so that you may not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
text_tl: Mumunti kong mga anak, ang mga bagay na ito ay isinusulat ko sa inyo upang kayo'y huwag mangagkasala. At kung ang sinoman ay magkasala, ay may Tagapamagitan tayo sa Ama, si Jesucristo ang matuwid:

parts:
If you, LORD, should keep watch over iniquities,
Lord, who could stand?

For with you there is forgiveness,
so that you may be feared.
text:
If you, LORD, should keep watch over iniquities,
Lord, who could stand?
For with you there is forgiveness,
so that you may be feared.
text_tl:
Kung ikaw, Panginoon, magtatanda ng mga kasamaan, Oh Panginoon, sinong tatayo?
Nguni't may kapatawarang taglay ka, upang ikaw ay katakutan.

parts:
Search me, O God, and know my heart;
test me, and know my anxious thoughts;

and see if there is any offensive way in me,
and lead me in the way everlasting.
text_tl:
Siyasatin mo ako, Oh Dios, at alamin mo ang aking puso; subukin mo ako, at alamin mo ang aking mga pagiisip:
At tingnan mo kung may anomang lakad ng kasamaan sa akin, at patnubayan mo ako sa daang walang hanggan.

parts: Confess, then, your sins to one another and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man is very powerful in its working.
text: Confess, then, your sins to one another and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man is very powerful in its working.
text_tl: Mangagpahayagan nga kayo sa isa't isa ng inyong mga kasalanan, at ipanalangin ng isa't isa ang iba, upang kayo'y magsigaling. Malaki ang nagagawa ng maningas na panalangin ng taong matuwid.

parts: through all prayer and supplication, praying at all times in the Spirit, and to this end keeping alert with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints,
text: through all prayer and supplication, praying at all times in the Spirit, and to this end keeping alert with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints,
text_tl: Na magsipanalangin kayo sa Espiritu ng lahat ng panalangin at daing sa buong panahon, at mangagpuyat sa buong katiyagaan at daing na patungkol sa lahat ng mga banal,

parts: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
text: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
text_tl: Mapapalad ang mga mahabagin: sapagka't sila'y kahahabagan.

parts: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
text: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
text_tl: Magmaawain kayo, gaya naman ng inyong Ama na maawain.

parts: not by works done in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to His mercy He saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,
text: not by works done in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to His mercy He saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,
text_tl: Na hindi dahil sa mga gawa sa katuwiran na ginawa nating sarili, kundi ayon sa kaniyang kaawaan ay kaniyang iniligtas tayo, sa pamamagitan ng paghuhugas sa muling kapanganakan at ng pagbabago sa Espiritu Santo,

parts: but God, being rich in mercy, because of His great love with which He loved us,
even when we were dead in trespasses, made us alive together with Christ — by grace you have been saved —
text:
but God, being rich in mercy, because of His great love with which He loved us,
even when we were dead in trespasses, made us alive together with Christ — by grace you have been saved —
text_tl:
Nguni't ang Dios, palibhasa'y mayaman sa awa, dahil sa kaniyang malaking pagibig na kaniyang iniibig sa atin,
Bagama't tayo'y mga patay dahil sa ating mga kasalanan, tayo'y binuhay na kalakip ni Cristo (sa pamamagitan ng biyaya kayo'y nangaligtas),

parts:
For you, O Lord, are good and forgiving,
and abundant in lovingkindness to all who call on you.
text:
For you, O Lord, are good and forgiving,
and abundant in lovingkindness to all who call on you.
text_tl: Sapagka't ikaw, Panginoon, ay mabuti, at mapagpatawad, at sagana sa kagandahang-loob sa lahat na tumatawag sa iyo.

parts:
He has told you, O man, what is good;
and what does the Lord require of you
but to do justice, and to love kindness,
and to walk humbly with your God?
text:
He has told you, O man, what is good;
and what does the Lord require of you
but to do justice, and to love kindness,
and to walk humbly with your God?
text_tl: Kaniyang ipinakilala sa iyo, Oh tao, kung ano ang mabuti; at ano ang hinihingi ng Panginoon sa iyo, kundi gumawa na may kaganapan, at ibigin ang kaawaan, at lumakad na may kababaan na kasama ng iyong Dios.

parts: But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
text: But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
text_tl: Datapuwa't sinasabi ko sa inyo, Ibigin ninyo ang inyong mga kaaway, at idalangin ninyo ang sa inyo'y nagsisiusig;

parts: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
text:
Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
text_tl:
Huwag kayong mangabalisa sa anomang bagay; kundi sa lahat ng mga bagay sa pamamagitan ng panalangin at daing na may pagpapasalamat ay ipakilala ninyo ang inyong mga kahilingan sa Dios.
At ang kapayapaan ng Dios, na di masayod ng pagiisip, ay magiingat ng inyong mga puso at ng inyong mga pagiisip kay Cristo Jesus.

parts: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful in it, with thanksgiving,
text: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful in it, with thanksgiving,
text_tl: Manatili kayong palagi sa pananalangin, na kayo'y mangagpuyat na may pagpapasalamat;

parts: Pray without ceasing.
text: Pray without ceasing.
text_tl: Magsipanalangin kayong walang patid;

parts: And let us not lose heart in doing what is right, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give out.
text: And let us not lose heart in doing what is right, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give out.
text_tl: At huwag tayong mangapagod sa paggawa ng mabuti: sapagka't sa kapanahunan ay magsisipagani tayo, kung hindi tayo manganghihimagod.

parts: And He said to them all, “If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow Me.
text: And He said to them all, “If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow Me.
text_tl: At sinabi niya sa lahat, Kung ang sinomang tao ay ibig sumunod sa akin, ay tumanggi sa kaniyang sarili, at pasanin sa arawaraw ang kaniyang krus, at sumunod sa akin.

parts:
I will instruct you and teach you in the way you shall go;
I will give counsel, with my eye upon you.
text:
I will instruct you and teach you in the way you shall go;
I will give counsel, with my eye upon you.
text_tl: Aking ipaaalam sa iyo at ituturo sa iyo ang daan na iyong lalakaran: papayuhan kita na ang aking mga mata, ay nakatitig sa iyo.

parts:
Trust in the Lord with all your heart,
and do not lean on your own understanding.

In all your ways acknowledge Him,
and He will make your paths straight.
text:
Trust in the Lord with all your heart,
and do not lean on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge Him,
and He will make your paths straight.
text_tl:
Tumiwala ka sa Panginoon ng buong puso mo, at huwag kang manalig sa iyong sariling kaunawaan:
Kilalanin mo siya sa lahat ng iyong mga lakad, at kaniyang ituturo ang iyong mga landas.

parts: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid, and do not be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.”
text: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid, and do not be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.”
text_tl: Hindi ba kita inutusan? Ikaw ay magpakalakas at magpakatapang na mabuti; huwag kang matakot, ni manglupaypay: sapagka't ang Panginoon mong Dios ay sumasa iyo saan ka man pumaroon.

parts: Let your way of life be free from the love of money, and be content with what you have, for He Himself has said, “I will never leave you, nor will I ever forsake you.”
text: Let your way of life be free from the love of money, and be content with what you have, for He Himself has said, “I will never leave you, nor will I ever forsake you.”
text_tl: Mangilag kayo sa pagibig sa salapi; mangagkasiya kayo sa inyong tinatangkilik: sapagka't siya rin ang nagsabi, Sa anomang paraan ay hindi kita papagkukulangin, sa anomang paraan ni hindi kita pababayaan.

parts: Come to Me, all you who labor and are burdened, and I will give you rest.
Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am meek and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
text:
Come to Me, all you who labor and are burdened, and I will give you rest.
Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am meek and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
text_tl:
Magsiparito sa akin, kayong lahat na nangapapagal at nangabibigatang lubha, at kayo'y aking papagpapahingahin.
Pasanin ninyo ang aking pamatok, at magaral kayo sa akin; sapagka't ako'y maamo at mapagpakumbabang puso: at masusumpungan ninyo ang kapahingahan ng inyong mga kaluluwa.

parts: Whatever you do, work from the soul, as for the Lord and not for people,
text: Whatever you do, work from the soul, as for the Lord and not for people,
text_tl: Anomang inyong ginagawa, ay inyong gawin ng buong puso, na gaya ng sa Panginoon, at hindi sa mga tao;

parts: being confident of this very thing, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus;
text: being confident of this very thing, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus;
text_tl: Na ako'y may lubos na pagkakatiwala sa bagay na ito, na ang nagpasimula sa inyo ng mabuting gawa, ay lulubusin hanggang sa araw ni Jesucristo:

parts: These things I have written to you so that you may know that you have eternal life — to you who believe in the name of the Son of God.
text: These things I have written to you so that you may know that you have eternal life — to you who believe in the name of the Son of God.
text_tl: Ang mga bagay na ito ay isinulat ko sa inyo, upang inyong maalaman na kayo'y mayroong buhay na walang hanggan, sa makatuwid ay sa inyong nananampalataya sa pangalan ng Anak ng Dios.

parts: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor rulers, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text:
For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor rulers, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text_tl:
Sapagka't ako'y naniniwalang lubos, na kahit ang kamatayan man, kahit ang buhay, kahit ang mga anghel, kahit ang mga pamunuan, kahit ang mga bagay na kasalukuyan, kahit ang mga bagay na darating, kahit ang mga kapangyarihan,
Kahit ang kataasan, kahit ang kababaan, kahit ang alin mang ibang nilalang, ay hindi makapaghihiwalay sa atin sa pagibig ng Dios, na nasa kay Cristo Jesus na Panginoon natin.

parts: “And I give them eternal life, and they shall never, ever perish, and no one shall snatch them out of My hand.
text: “And I give them eternal life, and they shall never, ever perish, and no one shall snatch them out of My hand.
text_tl: At sila'y binibigyan ko ng walang hanggang buhay; at kailan ma'y hindi sila malilipol, at hindi sila aagawin ng sinoman sa aking kamay.
